full_prompt_en: The image is a square painterly digital scene of a woman in a red coat walking across a wet surface scattered with small red leaves. She stands just left of center and faces right in strict side profile. A dark brimmed hat and short dark hair frame the top of her head. Her long scarlet coat or dress narrows at the waist and opens into a wind-swept trailing hem toward the left; black shoes touch the reflective ground. A thin dark shadow extends to the right from her feet. Behind her, an immense plain blue-gray field fills the upper half, with only very subtle horizontal texture and no buildings or trees. At about mid-height, a dense bright strip of red and orange leaf-like flecks stretches from edge to edge. The flecks thin out toward the foreground, exposing a cool blue reflective plane. Directly beneath the woman, a dark red mirrored figure descends almost to the lower edge, broken and wavering in the water. Small red shapes interrupt the reflection throughout. The viewpoint is level and distant enough that the woman appears compact within wide negative space, yet her red clothing remains the clearest silhouette. Light is even and cool across the blue field; the red coat and scattered flecks seem luminous by color contrast rather than a strong spotlight. The surface has fine painterly grain, small stippled red marks, and faint ripples that disturb the mirror image. The overall composition is simple and striking, built from a lone vertical figure, a dense horizontal red band, and a long downward reflection.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、带绘画质感的数字场景：一位穿红外套的女子走过散满小红叶的湿地。她站在中央略左，以严格侧影朝右。深色有檐帽和短暗发框住头顶。长猩红外套或裙在腰部收紧，下摆迎风向左拖开；黑鞋触到反光地面。一道细暗影从脚下向右伸。她身后，大片平静蓝灰色场填满上半部，只有极淡横向纹理，没有房屋或树木。画幅约中段，一条密集明亮的红橙色叶片般碎点从边到边铺开。碎点向前景逐渐变稀，露出冷蓝色反光平面。女子正下方，一道深红色镜像几乎垂到下画边，在水中断裂、摇晃。小红形一路打断倒影。视点平直且距离较远，女子在宽阔留白中显得紧凑，但红衣仍是最清楚的剪影。蓝色场里的光均匀而偏冷；红外套与散落碎点靠色彩对比发亮，而非强聚光。表面有细绘画颗粒、点点红痕与扰动镜像的浅波纹。整体构图简单而醒目，由一道孤立竖形、一条密集红横带和一条向下的长倒影搭成。
style_prompt_en: Painterly digital imagery sets a single saturated vermilion vertical accent against an immense cool blue-gray field. A dense middle band of tiny red-orange flecks spreads horizontally, then thins into a lower reflective plane. A long dark mirrored shape extends downward with soft interruptions and fine ripples. The upper region remains open and nearly flat, carrying only faint grain and horizontal brushing. Light is even, so color contrast rather than spotlighting creates luminosity. Edges of the main accent are clean enough to read, while scattered fragments and their reflections stay broken and textured. The composition is spare, graphic, and quiet, organized by one vertical, one broad horizontal, and a softened echo below.
style_prompt_zh: 带绘画感的数字图像把一道饱和朱红竖向点放在广大的冷蓝灰色场前。中段密集的红橙小碎片水平铺开，向下渐稀，进入较低的反光平面。一道长暗镜像往下伸，边缘有柔和间断与细波纹。上部保持开放且近乎平面，只带隐约颗粒与横向扫笔。光均匀，因此色彩对比而非聚光制造亮度。主要点缀的边缘足够干净可读，散落碎片及其倒影则破碎而有纹理。构图稀疏、图形化且安静，由一道竖线、一条宽横带与下方柔化回声组织。
